days.title: A quiet landing
days.intro: Arrive in Hong Kong at night. Transfer to your hotel, check in, and rest: two full Hong Kong days start tomorrow.
days.note: No sightseeing tonight. The city sights are on Nov 14 and Dragon’s Back with Shek O is on Nov 15. Your airport, exact landing time, and hotel are still to be added.

stops.title: Arrive in Hong Kong
stops.description: Clear arrivals and collect your bags. Arrange the onward transfer around your actual landing time.

stops.title: Hotel check-in & a late bite
stops.description: Go directly to your hotel, check in, and have a simple meal nearby if you are hungry. Let the hotel know if check-in will be late.

stops.title: Rest for tomorrow
stops.description: Rest after the journey. Tomorrow is for city streets and harbor lights; the hike gets its own day on Sunday.

days.title: Hong Kong, from lanes to lights
days.area: Central · Sheung Wan · the Peak · Kowloon
days.intro: A full day for the city: neighborhood lanes, views from the Peak, and the harbor after dark. Keep meals and coffee stops spontaneous.
days.note: Keep the morning neighborhood walk short if Peak queues are long. Tomorrow stays in Hong Kong, so there is no train departure to rush back for.

points.title: Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront
points.local_name: Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront · 尖沙咀海濱

points.title: Harbor lights & the Star Ferry
points.local_name: Central Star Ferry Pier · 中環天星碼頭

stops.title: Central, slowly
stops.description: Start with breakfast and a short walk through Central, keeping the first morning manageable after last night’s arrival.

stops.title: Sheung Wan lanes
stops.description: Continue into Sheung Wan for neighborhood lanes and a coffee before heading to the Peak.

stops.title: Victoria Peak
stops.description: Go up for the view, allowing room for queues. Shorten the earlier walk if you would rather spend more time here.

stops.title: Kowloon & a food crawl
stops.description: Cross to Kowloon and explore Mong Kok. Graze as you go, with flexible food stops rather than reservations.

stops.title: Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront
stops.description: Walk the harborfront for the skyline before a ferry crossing.

stops.title: Harbor lights & the Star Ferry
stops.description: Cross from Tsim Sha Tsui to Central for skyline views from the water, then return to your hotel at your own pace.

days.title: The greener side of Hong Kong
days.intro: With a second full Hong Kong day, there is room for both the city and the coast. Walk the Dragon’s Back ridge, then slow down in Shek O.
days.note: Use the hiking day for clear, dry weather. Swap Nov 14 and 15 locally if conditions favor it. After dinner, pack for the next morning’s train.

stops.title: Dragon’s Back
stops.description: Travel to the trailhead and enjoy the ridge walk. Choose your exact trail variant and transport after checking the weather. The pin marks the ridge area, not a trailhead or GPS track.

stops.title: Shek O beach & village
stops.description: After the hike, transfer to Shek O for a relaxed beach and village afternoon before returning to the city.

stops.title: A harbor evening, if you have energy
stops.description: Once back in the city, add a waterfront walk or Star Ferry crossing only if you feel like it. Otherwise have dinner near your hotel and pack for tomorrow’s train.

days.title: From skyline to karst
days.intro: A travel day with a soft landing in the countryside. Aim for an early train, then go directly to Yangshuo instead of spending the night in Guilin.
days.note: Morning is your departure target, not a confirmed train time. If the available service arrives later, shorten or skip the countryside outing.
days.transfer: Rail to Guilin West + car to Yangshuo · services to confirm

points.title: Train from Hong Kong West Kowloon
points.local_name: Hong Kong West Kowloon · 香港西九龍

stops.title: Train from Hong Kong West Kowloon
stops.description: Book the service to Guilin West once sales open. Confirm the departure time and allow the station’s required check-in and border-processing buffer.

stops.title: Guilin West → Yangshuo
stops.description: Meet your prearranged driver at Guilin West and transfer directly to your Yangshuo accommodation.

stops.title: A gentle countryside introduction
stops.description: After check-in, take a short walk or easy bike ride near your accommodation. This pin is Yangshuo town; choose the actual route with your hotel.

days.title: Along the Yulong River
days.area: Village roads, karst peaks & time on the water
days.intro: Spend the day outside: an easy cycling loop through villages, a pause by the river, and a bamboo raft outing if conditions allow.
days.note: The map is an area guide, not a cycling track. Finalize bike pickup, the raft pier and route, and the return transfer locally before setting off.

stops.title: Cycle the Yulong River countryside
stops.description: Rent bikes and explore quiet village roads. Choose a loop that suits your hotel location and riding comfort.

stops.title: Yulong Bridge & village roads
stops.description: Use the old bridge area as a scenic waypoint; stop for photos and a leisurely lunch along the way.

stops.title: Jiuxian village & bamboo rafting
stops.description: Spend time around Jiuxian, then take a bamboo raft ride on an available Yulong River section. The pin marks the village, not a booked raft pier.

stops.title: Return to Yangshuo
stops.description: Return the bikes and keep dinner easy before tomorrow’s long transfer.

days.title: North to the mountains
days.intro: Treat this as a full transfer day. Arrange both cars ahead of time and give your Wulingyuan hotel your expected arrival time.
days.note: Confirm the exact Guilin departure station, train or connection, and arrival time before booking the pickup. Do not assume the onward train departs Guilin West.
days.transfer: Car + afternoon rail + car · late hotel check-in

points.title: Meet your driver at Zhangjiajie West

stops.title: Transfer from Yangshuo to Guilin
stops.description: Check out and take a prearranged car to the departure station shown on your train ticket. Leave room for traffic and the station buffer.

stops.title: Train to Zhangjiajie West
stops.description: Your planned afternoon rail leg is not yet booked. Confirm whether a direct train or a connection fits this date; keep the evening free for travel.

stops.title: Meet your driver at Zhangjiajie West
stops.description: Have the driver track your actual arrival and agree a meeting point before traveling.

stops.title: Settle into Wulingyuan
stops.description: Continue to your Wulingyuan hotel and check in late. Have the hotel arrange an easy dinner option if needed. The map shows the town center, not a hotel.

days.title: Above the sandstone pillars
days.intro: Your first full forest park day is for the high viewpoints: the Avatar-like pillars of Yuanjiajie and the broad mountain views from Tianzi.
days.note: Plan the park entry, shuttle, lift and cableway sequence with your hotel the night before. Route order can change with queues, weather and operating arrangements.

stops.title: Enter from the Wulingyuan side
stops.description: Head to the forest park early with your entry and internal transport plan ready. The pin marks the Wulingyuan base area.

stops.title: Yuanjiajie: the Avatar mountains
stops.description: Explore the pillar viewpoints and walking paths, allowing time to pause rather than racing between platforms.

stops.title: Tianzi Mountain
stops.description: Continue to Tianzi Mountain for a different perspective on the forest of stone peaks.

stops.title: Return to Wulingyuan
stops.description: Stay at the same hotel tonight. Have a quiet dinner and prepare for another park day.

days.title: Down in the forest
days.intro: A stream-level walk and another panorama, then back to the same Wulingyuan hotel. There is no hotel change tonight.
days.note: Agree the park exit and return pickup with your hotel. Pack tonight and arrange tomorrow’s early car, Tianmen entry, luggage storage and airport transfer.

points.title: Back to the same Wulingyuan hotel

stops.title: Golden Whip Stream
stops.description: Follow a manageable section of the stream-side path. The marker indicates the stream area; choose the exact start and finish locally.

stops.title: Huangshizhai
stops.description: Head to Huangshizhai for another panorama, choosing walking or cableway arrangements to match your energy and conditions.

stops.title: Back to the same Wulingyuan hotel
stops.description: Have dinner and prepare for an early checkout. This is the third night at the same hotel.

days.title: Tianmen, then on to Shanghai
days.intro: Check out of your Wulingyuan hotel early and visit Tianmen on the morning of departure. Continue to Shanghai on the planned evening flight, without a hotel move the night before.
days.note: Prearrange a car and allow a generous transfer buffer. Plan roughly 75–90 minutes to the confirmed meeting point; this is a planning allowance, not a quoted journey time. Confirm the Nov 21 flight before committing to this sequence.
days.transfer: Early car + morning Tianmen visit + planned evening flight

stops.title: Check out & drive to Tianmen
stops.description: Take your luggage when leaving Wulingyuan. Aim for the earliest available Tianmen entry; have your driver confirm the current Route C meeting point, which may differ from older downtown-cableway instructions.

stops.title: Tianmen Mountain · Route C
stops.description: The current operator notice keeps Route C open while the main cableway is suspended for renovation. It uses the Tianmen Cave Express cableway and mountain escalators. Allow a generous half-day, with a firm finish time set by your flight.

stops.title: Lunch, luggage & airport transfer
stops.description: Arrange luggage storage or a transfer provider’s luggage service in advance. Collect bags near Zhangjiajie city and continue to the airport; avoid a return to Wulingyuan. This pin marks the city, not a confirmed storage location.

stops.title: Fly nonstop to Shanghai, if confirmed
stops.description: The Nov 21 nonstop flight, departure time and Shanghai airport still need confirmation. Leave enough buffer for airport check-in and possible queues at Tianmen.

stops.title: Your Shanghai hotel
stops.description: Hold the hotel night of Nov 21 even if the flight lands after midnight on Nov 22. Confirm late check-in with the hotel.

days.title: A slower start, a new skyline
days.intro: Sleep in after the late flight. Keep Yu Garden on Sunday, then explore the old-city streets and Pudong’s riverfront at an unhurried pace.
days.note: Yu Garden is normally closed on Mondays, so keep it today. Its current visitor page lists last entry at 16:00 and closing at 16:30; check your date before booking. If your arrival is delayed, prioritize the garden before the riverfront.

points.title: An observation deck
points.local_name: Shanghai Tower · 上海中心大厦

stops.title: Yu Garden
stops.description: After a slower start, visit the garden before its afternoon last-entry cutoff. Leave time for the surrounding old-city lanes.

stops.title: Food stops around the old city
stops.description: Leave the lunch stop open and browse the neighborhood at your own pace.

stops.title: Pudong riverfront
stops.description: Head to Lujiazui and walk by the river for a view back across the Huangpu.

stops.title: An observation deck
stops.description: Shanghai Tower is a possible deck choice, subject to tickets and visibility. Skip it if you prefer to stay outdoors.

days.title: Leafy streets & a Bund farewell
days.area: Fuxing Park → Wukang & Anfu → the Bund
days.intro: A full day for Fuxing Park, tree-lined streets and café breaks, with a final skyline walk along the Bund after dark.
days.note: Take a taxi or metro between the neighborhood walk and the Bund. Enjoy a final Shanghai evening, then pack for tomorrow’s departure.

stops.title: Fuxing Park
stops.description: Ease into the day with a park stroll and breakfast or coffee nearby.

stops.title: Wukang Road
stops.description: Walk the tree-lined streets and pause whenever something catches your eye.

stops.title: Anfu Road
stops.description: Continue the neighborhood wandering, with time for shops, coffee and a late lunch.

stops.title: The Bund
stops.description: Finish with the classic riverfront skyline walk.

days.title: One last morning
days.intro: If your flight leaves enough room, enjoy a final neighborhood breakfast. Otherwise, make the morning an easy airport transfer.
days.note: No departure route is plotted: your hotel, flight time, and Shanghai airport have not been specified.

stops.title: Breakfast & a neighborhood walk
stops.description: Keep it close to your hotel and set a firm turnaround time based on the booked flight.

stops.title: Depart Shanghai
stops.description: Check out, collect bags, and leave for the correct airport with the airline’s required buffer.
